verified_external_results.name: MIM_TO_NEIGHBORHOOD_EQUIVALENCE_REPRESENTATIVE
verified_external_results.source: Algorithmica: On the Tractability of Optimization Problems on H-Graphs, Lemma 1 restating the standard mim/neighborhood-equivalence connection
verified_external_results.verified_claim: For an n-vertex graph and cut A, mim(A)<=w iff every subset S of A has a subset R of size at most w with the same external neighborhood.
verified_external_results.consequence: The number of 1-neighborhood equivalence classes is at most the number of subsets of A of size <=w, hence n^{O(w)}.

verified_external_results.name: MIM_D_NEIGHBORHOOD_META_THEOREM
verified_external_results.verified_claim: Given a branch decomposition of mim-width w, fixed formulas/problems handled by the framework admit n^{O(w)} algorithms via d-neighborhood equivalence.
verified_external_results.role: Confirms d-neighborhood equivalence is a standard DP boundary compression mechanism; does not certify CSZ-specific sufficiency.

verified_external_results.name: LIST_K_ON_BOUNDED_QUICKLY_COMPUTABLE_SIM_WIDTH
verified_external_results.source: Brettell et al., Theoretical Computer Science 955 (2023), 113825
verified_external_results.verified_claim: For each fixed k, List k-Colouring is polynomial-time solvable on classes of bounded and quickly computable sim-width.

verified_external_results.name: WIDTH_RECOGNITION_HARDNESS
verified_external_results.source: ICALP 2025 Mim-Width Is paraNP-Complete; ICALP 2026 On the Hardness of Recognizing Graphs of Small Mim-Width and Its Variants
verified_external_results.verified_claim: Computing/recognizing mim-width and sim-width remains NP-hard even under constant-width promises/small constant thresholds.
verified_external_results.consequence: B1B1A must construct a common layout from source/decomposition certificates; it must not invoke global optimization for mim-width.

verified_external_results.name: SIMULTANEOUS_GRAPH_PARAMETERS_2026
verified_external_results.verified_claim: For fixed simultaneous C-number, mim-width is among the parameters whose boundedness is preserved when the base class C has bounded mim-width.
verified_external_results.exact_model: One graph G is represented by a base graph H in C and constant-size label sets L(v), with uv in E(G) iff uv in E(H) and L(u) intersects L(v).
mismatch: The available statement explicitly lists mim-width but not sim-width.
Our object is three prescribed edge sets I_sigma,1,I_sigma,2,I_sigma,3 sharing component vertices, not one graph already given as a constant-label filtering of a bounded-mim base graph.
No constant simultaneous C-number representation of our three-layer system has been established.
The result does not directly produce one common branch decomposition good for all three given layers.

verified_external_results.name: PARTITIONED_PROBE_Pt_WARNING
verified_external_results.verified_claim: 3-Colouring is NP-complete on partitioned probe P_t-free graphs for t>=6.
verified_external_results.consequence: Existence of a P7-free completion/full quotient is not by itself an algorithmic tractability certificate.

conditional_counting_observation.one_layer: If one common cut A has mim_{I_sigma,i}(A)<=w, every subset of A∩R_i has a representative of size <=w for its external neighborhood in that layer, so there are n^{O(w)} possible 1-neighborhood classes.
conditional_counting_observation.three_layers_four_actual_colors: There are 3*4=12 processed survivor-color subsets. Their joint 1-neighborhood signature count is n^{O(12w)} on a common cut.
conditional_counting_observation.all_B0_coarse_classes: If a common layout simultaneously gives width w for every layer of every one of at most B(s) coarse classes, the crude joint count is n^{O(12*w*B(s))}.
conditional_counting_observation.firewall: This counts neighborhood signatures only; it does not prove that these signatures preserve CSZ source semantics, internal component feasibility, or reconstruction.

common_layout_search.exact_question: Does every source-bound three-layer incidence system admit an efficiently constructible common branch decomposition T with max over cuts and i of mim_{I_sigma,i}(cut) <= q(|S|)?
